verdict.rationale: Stable's own virtual-mailbox pages say it forwards packages worldwide at discounted rates, which covers the forwarding part of the story. Nothing in the evidence addresses which carriers it accepts, consolidating multiple packages, or holding packages for pickup. missing for 10: evidence of acceptance from all major carriers (UPS/FedEx/DHL/USPS), package consolidation, hold-for-pickup option, independent or hands-on corroboration of package forwarding.

support.subject: As a digital nomad, the address accepts packages from all major carriers and can consolidate or hold them for pickup or forwarding

citations.quote: Manage mail from anywhere with a digital mailbox — scan mail, forward packages, deposit checks, and more.
Ship: Forward anywhere in the world, discounted rates included.
